title: Git as Agent Infrastructure
youtube_title: Git as Agent Infrastructure: Branches, Worktrees and Diffs | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 5
description: An agent can change twenty files in thirty seconds, which makes Git the backbone of agentic work, not just version control. This chapter covers small commits, commit messages that agents write and sign, a branch and worktree per task, cloud agents, reviewing through diffs at volume, and history as documentation.
